title: Reserve Bank of India imposes monetary penalty on Bank of Baroda
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated June 30, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹63.60 lakh (Rupees Sixty three lakh sixty thousand only) on Bank of Baroda (the bank) for non-compliance with certain provisions of directions issued by RBI on ‘Fair Practices Code for Lenders’ and ‘Know Your Customer (KYC)’.
